name: Food safety
what: Meet the Food Standards Code, register or license the food business, appoint a food safety supervisor where required, and be inspected.

layers.who: Food Standards Australia New Zealand (the Food Standards Code)
State food authority or health department (higher-risk businesses)
State food authority or health department
Local council (registration of retail and food service businesses)

consistency_note: One national food code, adopted by each state's food law; registration, licensing and inspection are run differently by each state and by councils.

basis.source: Accommodation and food services industry (industry information)
basis.quote: All food sold, processed or handled for sale in Australia and New Zealand must comply with the Food Standards Code .

basis.source: Performance Benchmarking of Australian and New Zealand Business Regulation: Food Safety
basis.quote: Local councils play a key role in the administration and enforcement of consumer food safety regulation, except in the Australian territories.
